authority: User requests complete missing comparisons and choose the better-performing method
development_results: Diagnostic only, no independent superiority or precision adoption

role_specific_practical_use.both_below_threshold: No qualified precise-recovery method selected for this role
role_specific_practical_use.only_one_reaches_threshold: Prefer that program provisionally within the declared conditional role, disclose other method's failed counts
role_specific_practical_use.both_reach_threshold: Compare pass counts, paired parameter errors, frozen heldout residuals and actual CPU; comparable accuracy permits choosing lower-cost program without claiming universal precision superiority

symmetric_paired_error_claim.eligible_data: Fresh independent paired blocks only; all 18 remain in denominator
symmetric_paired_error_claim.block_score: Maximum of all three role case scores
symmetric_paired_error_claim.directional_win: Both programs assessable in all roles, competitor score positive, own score <= 0.9 competitor score; all failures, zeros and ties nonwins
symmetric_paired_error_claim.precision_rate_gate: Own precision pass count at least competitor count in each role
symmetric_paired_error_claim.scope: Conditional adapted solver only; not native ADAM or full mechanism discovery

gaussian_quasi_likelihood_baseline: Fixed development comparator; no official WENDy label or independent superiority inferred
full_method_adoption: Still requires same-fit open structure and parameter precision, null/near-equivalent controls and a compatible adopted-version confirmation protocol; conditional comparison alone cannot close this gate
prohibited: treat both methods failing as useful equivalence
